decision: DRF-03 / CMP-10 (S03b) — advisory per-runtime-generation compatibility disclosure

shape.min_runtime: oldest known generation that renders the experience (dropping optional parts) | null
shape.full_runtime: oldest known generation that renders it with nothing dropped | null
shape.has_drops: true when any compatible generation drops an optional component

rules: advisory only: never blocks saving or publishing (blocking stays in BuilderPublishedExperienceVersionService)
computed from the publishable schema (hidden editor sections excluded)
dropped lists the root of each omitted optional subtree by id and type only — never schema values
null when the schema fails structural validation
an optional component unsupported by a generation is dropped there, so it must be disclosed here before publishing (no silent drops)
